text.en: This Order may be cited as the Antiquities and Treasure Trove (Ancient . Monuments and Historical Sites) Order, 2006. Publication of schedule of ancient monuments and historical sites.

The monuments and sites published in the Schedule have been declared by order of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan in Council to be ancient monuments and historical sites for the purposes of this Act.
